statement: For smooth projective X of dimension n and a smooth ample hyperplane Y, the table distinguishes restriction on Pic, Pic0, Picτ and discrete quotients. statement: The draft asserts injectivity H1(X,G)→H1(Y_Kbar,G) for normal irreducible projective X/k, k algebraically closed, dimX≥2, a geometric generic hyperplane and an affine group G with an uncertain exclusion of multiplicative factors.

statement: The displayed αp/μp cohomology formulas and Frobenius operators are unreliable as transcribed. Standard fppf sequences distinguish αp=ker(F:Ga→Ga) from μp=ker([p]:Gm→Gm).

check_reason: Kernel structure and properness are separate claims with different proof dependencies.

statement: A proper flat family over a normal integral base is used to extend a generically Cartier horizontal cycle, assuming suitable S2/regularity fibre conditions and essentially proper representable Picard functor. The proof normalizes a divisor over traits, uses a closed locus T in Pic, and attempts to show T→S is an isomorphism.

his_words: en se passant de l’hypothèse ... représentable

statement: Under the stated noetherian codimension-one/intersection hypotheses, with f regular and A/f reduced, functions regular on D(f) and at the generic points of V(f) extend; units satisfy the analogous intersection. If (f) is prime, every unit of A_f is uniquely εf^n.

statement: A proper family over a complex analytic local base, or its corresponding proper scheme, is locally projective if all infinitesimal thickenings of the closed fibre are projective. statement: The letter proposes an extension from analytic local rings to good henselian rings, described via regular local presentations and geometrically regular formal fibres. This establishes the punctured henselian assertion with fewer hypotheses; the arbitrary-open m-adic variant is a separate question.
